House rules for visitor flow
Staff will learn how the desk handles it
Companion Animal Travel Desk
Purpose: this section keeps pet travel check-ins calm, clear, and fair for every traveler.

At Aurelia Skyways, the Companion Animal Travel Desk gives passengers steady guidance before departure so they know what to expect and what to bring. The first conversation should stay friendly, simple, and focused on the animal's needs, with the passenger coordinator explaining each required step in plain words. Staff should listen carefully, confirm details without rushing, and keep the traveler informed if a document, crate, or animal comfort check is needed before acceptance.

When a pet arrives, the desk should protect the calm of the area and make room for patient handling. Animals must be treated gently, never crowded, and never left waiting without a staff member checking on them. If a traveler seems unsure, the team should slow down, repeat the next step, and offer practical help without sounding sharp or impatient. Clear handoffs matter, so anyone taking over should know what has already been done and what still needs attention.

[[FACT F002]] When the lounge is in use, staff should keep the entrance orderly, speak softly, and make sure only the right people enter. [[FACT F016]] If a pet relief area is being used, the team should point travelers to the correct access point and remind them to keep the area clean and secure. These directions help the desk stay steady, respectful, and easy to follow for both people and pets.

If a case feels unclear or a traveler needs extra support, contact the senior coordinator right away.
